sources.title: Affine Subnet Debates Reverting Recent King Models and Margin ...
sources.snippet: Miners and developers on Affine (SN120) are calling for the reversion of the last four king models, citing unfair advantages from low-margin crowns and spam. The team increased the margin threshold but remains divided on whether to revert recent champions. A new teacher model is also planned within 24-48 hours.
